fact: Guineematin reports on 14 May 2026 that a mission under an ordre de mission dated 30 March 2026 was deployed in Labé prefecture to accompany the systematic registration (immatriculation) of primary pupils, with each pupil photographed at school through the Direction préfectorale de l'éducation's examinations officer and the school delegates (DSEE); the article is about money wrongly collected for the photographs, gives no count of schools or pupils registered, and does not describe the platform or say who enters the records.
title: Labé : un cadre de la DPE cité dans une affaire présumée de détournement de près de 200 millions GNF
